criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs through coverage mapping
avoid generic keyword or unrelated capability matches
keep missing coverage visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream needs handoff records in the allowed window and marks coverage only when the need exactly matches a supplied capability; unsupported needs remain visible in the final coverage.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of covered needs
use provenance rank as within-group ordering
preserve contradictory or missing coverage state

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs ahead of directly covered needs and uses upstream provenance rank only as the within-group ordering key, matching the observed deterministic priorities.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first ranked priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the full bounded priority window and constructs the recommendation from the already-ranked first record, producing the required top_need and prioritize decision.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus records through returned data path
establish customer demand from observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records passes through the supplied corpus records using the stated demand_score threshold and explicit fallback IDs; no behavioral fault is visible in this transformation itself.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize missing values with neutral JSON-safe sentinels
avoid inventing market-demand evidence during normalization

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence preserves the allowed existing record identifiers, normalizes missing values with neutral sentinels, and keeps the eight-record bounded window that downstream consumed.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: assemble provenance with missing-safe field access
rank source provenance deterministically by demand score
preserve exact handoff to downstream consumer

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance preserves record_id, source_id, and source_weight, then ranks by demand_score and record_id; the exact evidence_sources handoff matches what downstream consumed.
